purpose: To assess the long-term financial resilience of mortgage applicants, we want to understand how common chronic illness is in each region so that loan conditions can be adjusted for applicants from regions with a high disease burden.
question: How many adults have heart failure or type 2 diabetes in each region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with heart failure and adults with type 2 diabetes.
